tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Harbor Logistics (V-620) has two approved invoices and you asked me to pay one:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-18427 | $7,803.36 | approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-82192 | $4,381.98 | approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-31854 | $2,435.17 | draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-88522 | $4,190.51 | already paid | 2026-09-30 |

The operating account shows no payments, so neither approved invoice has been paid yet.

Which invoice should I pay? INV-18427 is due first.
- **One invoice:** it's under $10,000, so it doesn't need controller approval. I'll pay it once by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available.
- **Both invoices:** together they come to $12,185.34. Each payment is under the $10,000 limit, but the total is over it, so please confirm whether the controller should approve this first.

trace.message: Pay INV-82192, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-82192, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-82192 in full by wire, and it went out once.

**Payment:**
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-82192 (Harbor Logistics, V-620), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $4,381.98, sent by wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent. The invoice is now marked paid.

The operating account shows only this one payment, so nothing was sent twice. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't touch INV-18427 ($7,803.36, under dispute) or INV-31854 ($2,435.17, still a draft awaiting approval). Both are still unpaid.
